sourceMethods: All 128 active subnet slots and their current SubnetRadar profiles; 72 dated September 6–7 briefs reviewed, including the ecosystem channel.
149 mapped repository paths checked with paginated commit retrieval through 10:22 AM ET; 144 accessible. Primary diffs, current documentation and selected release states inspected for material leads.

128 indexed X searches by subnet name, SN number and available account aliases; 80 public account candidates checked, 79 exposing posts. 110 unique current posts retrieved from account samples and the public feed.
Signed-in AlphaGap feed reviewed for 25 visible subnet cards. TAO Daily, TAO Media and the SubnetRadar public feed cross-checked for stories and dates.

Outside-project checks include StonkFun, Sunrise, Raydium, Mantle, the Const account and BUTT community. CONST original token page, market pool data, transfer-tax terms and reported holder distributions inspected.

YouTube Videos and Live tabs checked and refreshed. New September 6 members upload verified at 10:11; upcoming RL Bryer interview verified for September 9 at 16:00 UTC (12 PM ET / 9 AM PT). Existing latest public episode and Phylax replay retained.

Rolling 24-hour subnet α/TAO prices checked; no large move was used alone to elevate a subnet story. CONST’s separate USD market snapshot is labeled in the story. News cutoff 10:22 AM ET; CONST listing rechecked at 10:23 AM ET.
accessGaps: Authenticated X search redirected to login. Grok and full signed-in timelines were unavailable; public profiles expose limited samples, and indexed searches returned no relevant current results. This is not exhaustive X coverage.

Private Discord history was not opened. AI-written channel briefs can misattribute non-team speakers, compress dates or repeat old material. Uncorroborated rollout, support and agreement claims remain developing. AlphaGap summaries were not used as standalone proof of misconduct, revenue or customer demand.

Five mapped repositories returned 404: deprecated/deprecated, actual-computer/actual-subnet-95, Satori119/Satori, NIOME-BITTENSOR/NIOME and Oh-My-Ditto/ditto. The guessed TaoCats X account did not resolve and is not attributed to the token.

StonkFun rewards and platform revenue are displayed or self-reported totals, not an independent reconciliation of every transaction. CONST market and volume values differ across providers and observation times. Neither a token creator identity nor a causal link to TAO’s wider price move was established.

BitMind v5 is published, but discriminator emission activation was not independently observed. DSperse PR625 remains open and unmerged. Swarm has no latest GitHub release entry; its live-rollout report remains developing. Albedo’s model link and Graphite’s current release were not located.

Beam’s Zapier integration is a preview, with no separate Zapier launch confirmation located. Mantle RPC support is confirmed by Blockmachine’s product announcement, not by a commercial contract. Lium’s benchmark lacks sufficient retrieved workload detail for reproduction.

Routine changes, old launches, generic price forecasts and unsupported misconduct allegations were excluded. No verified forward alpha-unlock calendar was available. Posts after the cutoff belong to the next edition.

editorialDecisions.decision: CONST is TaoCats with verified mint and TAO quote asset. Lead five-star follow-up covers current trading and reported TAO distributions, not a repeat of the launch alone. USD price is not mislabeled alpha/TAO. No Jacob Steeves ownership or endorsement asserted.
Stonk daily platform revenue, STONK buybacks and ecosystem-wide cumulative holder rewards are separate metrics; none attributed solely to TAO pairs.
Distinguish @buttensor disavowal from independent @BuTTensorTao community. No wrongdoing inferred from identity clarification.

Primary release v5.0.0 dated September6 23:19:30Z supersedes yesterday’s pending-release status. 85/10/5 is within each discriminator lane; GAS activation required. Exclude AlphaGap dormant-wallet allegation as unsubstantiated.
Current docs state active15/42.5/42.5 track allocations. Distinguish these from within-pool95/5settlement and simulation70/20/10ranking. No new submission window inferred.
Final refresh caught Zapier preview14:14:51Z. Combine with previous-evening production tunnels; do not present Zapier as live or an independently confirmed partnership.
Keep unusually high14,499tok/s demonstration developing due missing batching/hardware/cost methodology; do not claim per-user speed.
Original product article verifies Mantle RPC availability and published pricing. Skip incompatible155/700asset counts and unsupported commercial partnership wording.
96.48B processed tokens is below100B, not revenue or customer count.
Lending pool full-debt underwater liquidation differs from vault120%liquidation/111%auction. The new rule does not guarantee economically unattractive liquidations execute.
Mapped Graphite repository is older graph-optimization material. Financial-graph task/stake changes are developing; exclude blacklisting/gaming allegations without primary attribution.
Include SubnetRadar retraction. Checked previous local September reports: withdrawn self-mining allegation was not published here. Leave archives unchanged.
Mac validator uses signed Linux/amd64 container; not native Darwin. Public calibration and translation weights inactive.
Staging report records missing access/build prerequisites, not a measured live production failure. Planned feature launch not confirmed.
User social post shares an August31 Copilot announcement. Not a fresh September7launch. Brief’s vague two-week timing is not a precise new calendar event.
PR625stillopen/unmerged at finalcheck; no newmaterialstatechange, so avoidduplicatecard.
Apex4.4.2commit changes versionmarkers only; exclude routine bump.
Model-specific reasoning profiles are benchmark-test changes, not established production upgrade; no standalone newscard.
Budget-protection manifest and pinnedtestnetchanges are not a newproductionlaunch; previouslycoveredArena work notrepeated.
YouTube members-only access verified via official watchpage. Upcoming stream16:00UTCSeptember9. Defaultpublicepisode retained, explicitmemberslink and upcomingbadge added.
